description: Load the full prose for every scene in a chapter, concatenated in order. Provide chapter_id or chapter, plus project_id. Canonical targeting uses chapter_id; numeric chapter remains available as a read-scope compatibility alias resolved from canonical sort order. Expensive — only use when you need to read an entire chapter. Capped at 10 scenes. Use find_scenes first to confirm the chapter exists.

chapter.description: Read-scope compatibility alias resolved from canonical chapter sort order. Not a structural mutation target.

name: get_chapter_prose
